fact: The SARB lists a 2026 draft directive on issuing and acquiring payments for offshore merchants with a comment template, comments due on 17 July 2026; the page does not say how comments were submitted.

The SARB page links a consultation feedback note with detailed responses to comments received on the draft guidance note to Directive 1 of 2022, second round of consultation, hosted on the FIC website.

Home Affairs Minister Leon Schreiber published the Draft Revised White Paper on Citizenship, Immigration and Refugee Protection for public comment from 12 December 2025 to 31 January 2026, available on the Department's website with written comments accepted by email.
